facts.business: TAKE Limited operates an AI-powered health intelligence application (Take.Health) and is building an integrated digital health ecosystem including a Unified AI Platform and One Minute Clinic, focusing on personalised health optimisation, longevity, and preventive healthcare.

auditor.name: M/s. A. Raghavendra Rao & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY2025-26 due to inability to confirm ultimate realisable value of income tax assets (net) of Rs. 875.80 Lakhs pertaining to assessment years up to March 31, 2021, pending tax litigations; contingent liabilities for direct tax matters at Rs. 108.03 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026.

key_risks: Technology risks: dependence on third-party AI infrastructure (e.g., Anthropic's Claude); disruption, cost escalation, or change in terms could affect platform performance or economics.

Regulatory risks: evolving regimes in healthcare, diagnostics, digital health, nutraceuticals, data protection, medical device, and health-claims regulation could affect rollout of One Minute Clinic and longevity business.
Healthcare compliance risks: need to build robust clinical, quality, and compliance frameworks for direct-to-consumer diagnostics and health products.
Data privacy and cybersecurity risks: platforms process sensitive personal and medical data; breaches or non-compliance could result in reputational, financial, or legal exposure.
Competition risks: significant capital and competitive intensity in AI-enabled diagnostics, digital health, longevity, and wellness from established players and well-funded startups.
Talent acquisition risks: need for specialized technical, clinical, and regulatory talent in a competitive hiring environment.

Execution risks: key initiatives (One Minute Clinic, Unified AI Platform) at early/planning stages; scale, timeline, and financial contribution depend on execution across product development, partnerships, regulatory approval, and go-to-market.
Market adoption risks: uncertain pace of adoption of AI-enabled platforms and preventive healthcare models by providers and consumers could delay revenue contribution.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not given any loans or advances to any firms or companies in which the Directors are interested.
